title: Bonsai Automata
game_overview: An idle zen simulation featuring automated power and irrigation grids to grow bonsais to level 100, combined with reaction-based wilderness excursions.
winning_condition: Successfully discover and cultivate the rarest botanical specimen in the wilderness—the Mythic Golden Ginkgo Bonsai—to Level 100 Mastery in your automated sanctuary.
losing_condition: None. The game is a relaxing zen experience with no fail state or game over. When the expedition backpack reaches maximum capacity, the player simply cannot carry additional items and returns to the starting campsite portal to transport all gathered resources back to the sanctuary.

controls.action: Dig action in the radial shovel minigame during excursions.

controls.input: W/A/S/D or Arrow Keys / Virtual Joystick
controls.action: Move the botanist explorer across the excursion overworld.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Master Quest Gated Grid Expansions: The 8-phase grid territorial expansion progression enforces strict Master Quest branch rank prerequisites: Expansions I-IV (Inner Wings through Upper 8x16 Rows) are accessible from Rank 0; Expansions V & VI (Left 8x8 and Right 8x8 Wings) require completing at least one Master Quest branch to Rank 1; and Expansions VII & VIII (Southern Rows 8-15) require completing at least one branch to Rank 2. 2. Interactive Single-Phase Mini-Map Presentation: Renamed the 'Plots' market submenu to 'Grid Expansions' and transformed the interface into a single-phase presentation engine. An architectural SVG mini-map depicts the entire tri-field sanctuary (central 16x16 megagrid and elevated flanking 8x8 wings) using color telemetry: emerald green for currently active plots, pulsing amber gold for plots unlocked in the target phase, and muted slate for future locked plots. The panel details plot capacity, prerequisite Master Quest status, discounted Verdure pricing, and dynamic purchase acquisition.
sections.summary: Master-Quest Gated Grid Expansions, Single-Phase Focused Progression, and Sanctuary Architectural Mini-Map.
